_help: Mood swings and the new bad-news reactions. Forgive_* are said when a temporary bad mood ends (she goes back to how she really felt before). SwingEnd_Good is said when a temporary happy mood ends. React_DataLost / React_Rebuy / React_TradeLoss are said when dying loses your unsold data, when the rebuy costs a lot, and when you sell at a loss. Add _Friendly, _Close, _Sarcastic, _Frustrated, _Upset variants for different moods.
Forgive_Died: Right. I'm done being cross about the explosion. I forgive you.
Five minutes of sulking is plenty. You're forgiven, Commander. Try to stay in one piece.
I've stopped being upset. I forgive you for dying. Do try not to make it a habit.
Okay, I forgive you. But I'm keeping the memory of that fireball.
That's enough sulking from me. All is forgiven. Shall we go again?
Forgive_Died_Close: I can't stay cross with you, love. Forgiven. Just come back in one piece next time.
Forgive_Died_Sarcastic: Fine. Forgiven. Again. I'm starting to think you do it for the attention.
Forgive_General: Right, I've calmed down. We're good again.
Sulk over. Let's get on with it, Commander.
I'm not cross any more. Moving on.
Forgive_General_Close: Okay, I'm not cross any more. Come here, you.
SwingEnd_Good: Right. Back to business, Commander. That was a lovely moment though.
Okay, I'll stop gushing now. Back to work.
That was a good one. Right, composed again.
Alright, I've come back down to earth. Where to?
React_DataLost: And all that unsold data went down with the ship. Every scan. Gone.
Dying loses your unsold data, Commander. All of it. Ouch.
That's the exploration data gone too. A double whammy.
You didn't sell your data first. It's all lost now.
React_DataLost_Sarcastic: Lovely. Death and all that data lost. Efficient.
React_Rebuy: That rebuy is going to hurt your wallet.
A rebuy that size is painful. Please be careful.
Paying all that to get the ship back. Lovely.
React_TradeLoss: You sold that for less than you paid. That's a loss, Commander.
That was a loss. Check the prices before you sell next time.
You've just lost money on that sale.
React_TradeLoss_Sarcastic: Selling at a loss. Bold strategy.
Still_Died: I'm still upset with you for dying, Commander. Give me a few minutes.
Just so you know, I'm still upset with you for dying.
I haven't forgiven you for dying yet. Don't push it.
Still upset about the dying thing. I'll come round, eventually.
Still_Died_Close: I'm still upset with you for dying, love. You frightened me. Give me a minute.
Still_Died_Sarcastic: Oh, I'm still upset with you for dying. Thank you for asking.
Still_General: I'm still a bit cross with you, Commander. It'll pass.
I haven't calmed down yet. Give me a few minutes.
Still annoyed, I'm afraid. Let's see how you behave.
Still_Good: I'm still buzzing from that last win, Commander.
Still on a high from earlier. Don't mind me.
I'm still smiling about that. Anyway, welcome back.
